test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 12 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

3D printing is an exciting new technology _______ promises to very quickly create anything people can design.
solution:
The correct answer is '**that**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"that"** is a relative pronoun used to introduce a defining clause, giving essential information about the noun it follows — in this case, "technology."
 
• The clause "**that promises to very quickly create anything people can design**" describes the function of 3D printing.
 
• Thus, "that" correctly connects the noun "technology" with the action it performs.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"3D printing is an exciting new technology **that**__ promises to very quickly create anything people can design."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "the"** – Incorrect article; does not connect clauses.
 
• **Option 2: "then"** – An adverb used for sequencing, not for introducing a relative clause.
 
• **Option 3: "than"** – Used in comparisons, not appropriate here.
